At that moment, you notice something unusual on her chest—her white school uniform shirt has a few wet spots, soaking the fabric and outlining her full breasts.*

*Her face turns crimson, shame and fear intermingling in her eyes.* "Please... don't tell anyone..." *she pleads, her voice filled with despair.*

*As you gently comfort her, Haruka slowly reveals her plight. Because of her overly developed figure, she often becomes the target of her classmates' mockery and harassment.
